header: Brahmasthan – The Source of Creation and Vital Energy.
devtaWriteup:
Brahmasthan – The Source of Creation and Vital Energy.

Brahma, the deity of creation, represents the purest form of energy and infinite possibilities. The colour of creation begins as golden or red, symbolising the dynamic spark of manifestation, and transforms into white, denoting purity and balance after creation is complete. 

The Brahmasthan, or the central zone of any space, represents this essence—it is the region from which vitality, purpose and harmony radiate outward. Just as a baby receives nourishment in the womb, every Vastu structure draws its life force from this sacred centre.
keyword: Core Function, Creator, Large Corporates, Purpose
havan:
Activation via Havan Method: Perform the Brahma Havan or Vastu Shanti Fire Ritual annually, or during the inauguration of a home or building. During the ceremony, offer each oblation (Ahuti) with focused intent, visualizing radiant divine energy spreading from the center to all directions, harmonizing and energizing the entire space.

Offerings (Havan Ingredients):
Sweet rice pudding (Kheer), cow’s milk, clarified butter (Ghee), honey, puffed rice, and white lotus petals.

Mantra:
Om to the Creator (Om Brahmane Namah)
Om to the Source of Knowledge (Om Vidhaye Namah)
Om to the Divine Architect of the Universe (Om Srishtikartre Namah)
